name: @w6w-apps/folk
description: Manage folk CRM groups, people and companies via the folk External API.

w6w.longDescription:
folk is a CRM built around Groups — contact lists of People and Companies, each carrying its own set of custom fields. This app covers the vendor's public 'External API' in full: listing a network's groups and creating/updating/finding people and companies within one, reading a group's available custom fields, listing the folk teammates on a network, and checking that a key can reach a given network.

Good for syncing leads or portfolio contacts into a folk group from a form or another CRM, keeping a company record current as deal data changes elsewhere, or looking a contact up by name/email before deciding whether to create a duplicate.
